revision_reason: User authorized CPU admission change after aae4147. New content/session only; do not import old observations or reinterpret historical REJECT. Search, input, C computation and scoring unchanged.
schedule_reason: Predeclare seed-major execution with alternating algorithm order to reduce, not eliminate, time-order confounding. No formal P3 scores were observed when this schedule was chosen.
failure_policy: A terminal failed configuration consumes one unique budget and never scores; no automatic retry of terminal observations. Interrupted attempts are abandoned and re-evaluated as a complete warmup plus five measurements before becoming observations.
retest_policy: After each 12-evaluation trajectory, independently retest the distinct best valid configurations of its 4/8/12 prefixes. Equal candidates within that trajectory share one fresh warmup-plus-five group; different trajectories never share measurements. Retests are outside the unique search budget and never change the trajectory or original scores.
observation_policy: Each strategy receives only the space and its own ordered terminal observations. Grid and other trajectories are readable only by separate postprocessing after decisions have been persisted.
resource_and_clock_policy: Resource admission policy 2026-10-10-cpu-admission-v1; Recovery CPU warns only, Formal average <=30 and maximum <=60, both memory/disk limits unchanged. Core timer and all clock tolerances unchanged. Preserve during-run raw samples, CV/MAD, historical clock/resource caveats; no post-hoc filtering or history calibration.
batch_policy: A trajectory limit only checkpoints the predeclared schedule; it does not change 12-evaluation trajectories, prefixes, seeds, scoring or retests. Resume can increase the limit without changing experiment identity.
